verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file served at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt. Sentry also publishes markdown (.md) versions of its doc pages, an agent plugin that teaches coding agents how to set up Sentry, and an official MCP server that lets assistants read its documentation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt file's scope and structure, and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: One command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok how to install and configure Sentry for you.
@sentry/agent-plugin detects which assistants you have on your machine, lets you pick the ones you want, and wires the plugin into each.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects
